title: Length of joined nonempty fields
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type and let $fs$ be a nonempty finite list of finite lists over $\Gamma$. The length of the list formed by joining the fields, with one blank separator between consecutive fields, is the sum of the field lengths plus the number of fields minus one.
hypotheses_covered: $fs$ is a finite list of finite lists over $\Gamma$
